title: Reported hits and the raid’s material effect
reading: Local destruction and civilian deaths; limited overall military damage
basis: Aircrew claims are not a surveyed damage assessment. No destroyed target or confirmed fighter-kill symbols are drawn.

records.says: Initial assessment claimed damage exceeded expectations.
Pilot observations describe explosions and fires, including residential districts.
Postwar count: 87 killed, 151 seriously injured and more than 311 lightly injured in Japan.

title: Why the intended landing was not available
reading: Weather, fuel, disrupted timing and incomplete coordination
basis: The immediate crew experience and the official planning history explain different parts of the failure; do not blame it solely on weather or portray Chinese assistance as absent.

records.says: Could not raise Chuchow by radio; cloud and darkness prevented a landing.
Secrecy restricted Chinese information; fields expected arrivals later, and Chiang resisted using Chuchow.
